categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Newway Photomask Making Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of photomasks used in integrated circuits and display industries. Its product portfolio includes photomasks for flat panel displays (covering all generations G2.5 to G11 and technologies such as LCD, AMOLED, LTPS, LTPO, Mini-LED, Micro-LED, silicon-based OLED, and FMM) and semiconductor photomasks used in IC manufacturing, packaging, and semiconductor devices including MEMS sensors and RF chips. The company also provides photomasks for touch screens, PCBs, and FPCs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photolithography technologies including laser direct writing for pixelated patterns, half-tone and phase shift mask (PSM) technologies, and high-precision coating and cleaning processes. It has developed proprietary manufacturing techniques for high-generation photomasks, including G11 ultra-large size photomasks, high-precision half-tone photomasks, and advanced semiconductor photomasks down to 150nm/130nm process nodes. The production process is highly automated and customized, involving coating, exposure, development, etching, stripping, and cleaning steps under strict quality control and cleanroom conditions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic flat panel display manufacturers such as BOE, Tianma Microelectronics, TCL Huaxing, Shanghai Xianyao (JBD), and Huancai Star. In the semiconductor sector, customers include a leading domestic chip company and its suppliers, Huatian Technology, Ningbo SMIC Integration, Jingfang Semiconductor, Tongfu Microelectronics, Sanan Optoelectronics, and Guangxun Technology. The company serves industries including consumer electronics, automotive electronics, AI chips, MEMS sensors, and advanced semiconductor packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in Chengdu and Hong Kong. Its sales are predominantly domestic, with a small portion of revenue from overseas markets. The company is expanding production capacity in Xiamen and Chengdu to support domestic and global demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Newway Photomask operates upstream in the semiconductor and flat panel display supply chains as a key materials supplier. It provides critical photomask products that serve as the pattern transfer templates in lithography processes, essential for downstream IC fabrication, display panel manufacturing, and advanced packaging.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in high-generation photomask technologies, including high-precision half-tone masks, phase shift masks, and coating technologies. It invests heavily in R&D to support emerging display technologies like LTPO, Micro-LED, and silicon-based OLED, as well as advanced semiconductor packaging photomasks for nodes down to 28nm. Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity, enhancing product precision, promoting domestic supply chain localization, and developing new products to meet evolving customer needs in AI, automotive, and advanced electronics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized photomask products to flat panel display manufacturers, semiconductor foundries, packaging companies, and other electronics manufacturers. The company operates on a made-to-order production model with direct sales contracts and framework agreements with major customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Newway Photomask is a leading domestic photomask manufacturer, ranked sixth globally and second in China for flat panel display photomasks. It is one of only five global companies capable of producing G11 generation photomasks, competing with international giants like DNP, Photronics, SKE, and LG-IT. The company is recognized for breaking foreign monopolies in high-generation and high-precision photomask technologies and is a key player in China's semiconductor photomask market, especially in advanced packaging.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 875.5 million, a 30.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 190.86 million, up 28.27%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory driven by expanding capacity and increasing demand in downstream industries. Total assets were about RMB 2.24 billion with net assets of RMB 1.39 billion. R&D investment was RMB 37.6 million, accounting for 4.3% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Newway Photomask emphasizes its domestic leadership in high-generation, high-precision photomask manufacturing, breaking long-standing foreign technology monopolies. Its products cover the full spectrum of display and semiconductor photomasks with superior precision, quality, and customization capabilities. The company leverages its local presence to offer faster response times, reliable supply, and cost-effective solutions, supporting the domestic industry's drive for supply chain security and import substitution. Its continuous innovation and comprehensive product matrix enable it to meet diverse and evolving customer demands in cutting-edge display and semiconductor technologies.
